column1: # Written form <TAB> respelling the voice is given instead.
# Applied to a copy of the text right before synthesis only; the scripts
# and the EPUB keep the real spelling. Matching is whole-word and
# case-insensitive (a hyphen counts as a word boundary, an apostrophe does
# not), and longer entries are applied first so a phrase wins over a word
# inside it. Respellings were chosen by checking Kokoro's phonemizer
# output (IPA) for each candidate, the same way as the daily-news-briefing
# Arabic of the prayer, word by word
